|game_text=Deploy on Bunker; may immediately take any one [Endor] or [Death Star II] card into hand from Force Pile; reshuffle. While an Imperial leader here, your total Force generation is +1. If opponent controls Bunker, place Effect in Used Pile. [Immune to Alter]
|errata_history=This is the original printing of “Ominous Rumors (V)” in Virtual Modern (version 1 of 4): the card image in place when Virtual Set 23 was officially released (22 July 2024). The current text is [[Ominous Rumors (V) (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3). Each version is the Players Committee's own card image, quoted in full with its upload date; the image on each page is that version's image as published (unchanged). The PC card data (swccg-card-json) is cited as dating evidence only.
* '''Original''' (this page): the card image at official release (20 July 2024)<ref name="ht-335d47f">Players Committee card image, [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/335d47f6b929debedbac9376b863af4442469f36/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual23-Dark/hires/ominousrumors.png as uploaded] to the PC's Holotable image repository (current publisher endpoint: [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual23-Dark/large/ominousrumors.gif res.starwarsccg.org]; may serve a later printing) in commit [https://api.github.com/repos/swccgpc/holotable/git/commits/335d47f6b929debedbac9376b863af4442469f36 335d47f] “Set 23 new images”, 20 July 2024.</ref> prints: “Deploy on Bunker; may immediately take any one [Endor] or [Death Star II] card into hand from Force Pile; reshuffle. While an Imperial leader here, your total Force generation is +1. If opponent controls Bunker, place Effect in Used Pile. [Immune to Alter]”<ref name="cj-753083f">Dating evidence only: the PC card data [https://api.github.com/repos/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/git/commits/753083fc81fb2db289a978f23181e87ee0f181c2 swccg-card-json commit 753083f] “Set 23” (21 July 2024) first gave the card this wording.</ref> The card image prints no errata mark.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Ominous Rumors (V) (Errata)]]): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 23 release sheet with errata (Set-23-Plus-Errata.pdf)<ref name="sheet23-20240802">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-23-Plus-Errata.pdf Virtual Set 23 release sheet with errata] (PDF, 9 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, July 2024”; file created 2 August 2024). Released with [[Virtual Set 23]] (22 July 2024); the PDF is dated by its creation date.</ref>, page 2, file created 2 August 2024: “Deploy on Bunker; may immediately take any one [Endor] or [Death Star II] card into hand from Force Pile; reshuffle. While an Imperial leader here, your total Force generation is +1. If opponent controls Bunker, place Effect in Used Pile. [Immune to Alter]” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[Ominous Rumors (V)]] (Original). The sheet prints a partial slip under the label “•Ominous Rumors”: the lower part of the PC card image of [[Ominous Rumors (V)]] (published 21 July 2024) — the bars and game-text box down to the lower-left name — pixel for pixel the same, to be laid over the card named in its lower-left corner ([[Ominous Rumors]]). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Ominous Rumors (V) (Errata 2)]]): the errata card image (29 December 2024, for the PC's Set 24 errata)<ref name="ht-efc26cd">Players Committee card image, [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/efc26cd8f4f02c4acb5707cb0d67361cc69322ba/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual23-Dark/large/ominousrumors.gif as uploaded] to the PC's Holotable image repository (current publisher endpoint: [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual23-Dark/large/ominousrumors.gif res.starwarsccg.org]; may serve a later printing) in commit [https://api.github.com/repos/swccgpc/holotable/git/commits/efc26cd8f4f02c4acb5707cb0d67361cc69322ba efc26cd] “Set 24 Part 2 (Errata and fixes)”, 29 December 2024, for the PC's Set 24 errata. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261114014729/https://swccg.com/snapshots/psa/reflections381-batch2-primary-sources.html Internet Archive primary-source copy].</ref> prints: “Deploy on Bunker; may immediately take any one [Endor] or [Death Star II] card into hand from Force Pile; reshuffle. While an Imperial leader here, your total Force generation is +1. Perimeter Patrol is suspended. If opponent controls Bunker, place Effect in Used Pile. [Immune to Alter]”<ref name="cj-38d9f66">Dating evidence only: the PC card data [https://api.github.com/repos/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/git/commits/38d9f6686457284d0381b644d39a771467537a0c swccg-card-json commit 38d9f66] “Set 24 Errata” (13 January 2025) changed the card to this wording.</ref> '''What changed:''' “Perimeter Patrol is suspended.” was added before “If opponent controls Bunker”. Nothing else changed. The card image prints the errata mark “E1” at bottom right.
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Ominous Rumors (V) (Errata 3)]]): the errata card image (7 March 2026, for the PC's 2026 errata (“Tweak Set 2026”))<ref name="ht-23b4dc9">Players Committee card image, [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/23b4dc91123cec2827f5084f60e2378f88594306/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual23-Dark/large/ominousrumors.gif as uploaded] to the PC's Holotable image repository (current publisher endpoint: [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual23-Dark/large/ominousrumors.gif res.starwarsccg.org]; may serve a later printing) in commit [https://api.github.com/repos/swccgpc/holotable/git/commits/23b4dc91123cec2827f5084f60e2378f88594306 23b4dc9] “DS Errata”, 7 March 2026, for the PC's 2026 errata (“Tweak Set 2026”).</ref> prints: “Deploy on Bunker; may choose: Activate 1 Force for each opponent’s non-battleground location on table, or take Endor Shield into hand from Force Pile; reshuffle. Fenson, Kensaric, and Perimeter Patrol’s game text is canceled. Fallen Portal may not target Endor sites. [Immune to Alter]”<ref name="cj-12dc019">Dating evidence only: the PC card data [https://api.github.com/repos/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/git/commits/12dc019807542584225f1cde07e1787ad5121f03 swccg-card-json commit 12dc019] “Tweak Set 2026 - Dark” (14 March 2026) changed the card to this wording.</ref> '''What changed:''' The text after “Deploy on Bunker;” was rewritten: “may choose: Activate 1 Force for each opponent’s non-battleground location on table, or take Endor Shield into hand from Force Pile; reshuffle. Fenson, Kensaric, and Perimeter Patrol’s game text is canceled. Fallen Portal may not target Endor sites.” The [Endor]/[Death Star II] card fetch, the Imperial-leader Force generation bonus, the Perimeter Patrol suspension and “If opponent controls Bunker, place Effect in Used Pile.” were removed. The card image prints the errata mark “E2” at bottom right.
